# SVG to PNG Cloudflare Worker

A Cloudflare Worker that converts SVG images to PNG format (512px width) on the fly.

## API Usage

```
https://your-worker.your-subdomain.workers.dev/https://example.com/image.svg
```

### Example

Convert Wikipedia logo to PNG:

```
https://xxx.workers.dev/https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/80/Wikipedia-logo-v2.svg
```

## Features

- 🚀 Fast SVG to PNG conversion using Rust-based resvg
- 📏 Auto-resize to 512px width while maintaining aspect ratio
- 💾 24-hour CDN caching
- 🔒 URL validation and protocol restrictions
- 🌐 CORS-friendly

## Development

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 18+
- npm or yarn

### Setup

```bash
npm install
```

### Local Development

```bash
npm run dev
```

### Deploy

```bash
npm run deploy
```

## Configuration

Edit `wrangler.toml` to customize:

- Worker name
- Compatibility date
- Custom domains (routes)

## Technical Details

- Uses `@resvg/resvg-wasm` for high-quality SVG rendering
- Runs on Cloudflare Workers Edge Network
- WASM module bundled with worker
